first_revision.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single small readable diplomacy/subject-status game UI icon for the Victoria 3 mod 1776 Age of Revolutions. Primary request: create an icon for an autonomous protected state, the least restrictive level of vassalage, paying no regular financial tribute. Subject: one modest silver-gray shield resting above a gently open bronze hand, flanked by two short curved sprays of oxidized turquoise laurel leaves. Match the existing game's small painted subject icons: protectorate is a silver shield, tributary is a bronze hand holding a gold coin, vassal is a silver chess pawn, all framed by turquoise laurel leaves. This NEW icon must read as loose protective allegiance and retain its own silhouette. Small compact centered composition, nearly fills square canvas with around 8 percent transparent margin. Muted antique metals, hand-painted dimensional highlights, dark crisp edges, warm bronze hand, gray silver shield, pale turquoise patinated leaves. No coin, no money bag, no currency sign, no crown, no chain, no national emblem, no text, no label, no border, no circular background, no white or black backdrop. One icon only, not an icon sheet, no scene. Actual fully transparent background with clean alpha, no checkerboard painted into the artwork. Prioritize strong silhouette legible at 30 by 30 pixels.

second_revision.prompt: Edit the supplied VANILLA UI icon references to create ONE matching new subject icon, not a sheet. Image 1 is the actual vanilla protectorate icon (silver shield and teal wreath), image 2 is vanilla tributary (bronze hand with gold coin and teal wreath), image 3 is vanilla vassal (silver chess pawn and teal wreath). These actual raster references define the REQUIRED art direction; match them strictly. The previous generated ornate realistic artwork was rejected. Preserve the compact chunky shapes, restrained smooth semi-flat shading, low-detail antique silver and bronze, short muted teal laurel wreath, small-game-icon proportions of these originals. New center: a plain small silver shield WITH A SINGLE SIMPLE OPEN BRONZE HAND beneath it, suggesting protection without payment. The wreath must be as small and secondary as in vanilla, not a large decorative frame. All objects must remain clear and comparable in scale to the 30px originals. Do NOT add engraving, scratches, realistic metallic microtexture, dramatic lighting, bright gold, beads, ribbon, jewels, coins, crowns, national symbols, writing, a backdrop, or a modern vector logo. Output just one isolated compact matching vanilla icon on genuinely transparent alpha background, centered square canvas with the same modest transparent margins as the references. Render as a legible game sprite intended to be reduced to 30 pixels, not an illustration or a large ornate emblem. Keep the exact muted palette of the references.
